chains.title: Alt A may strengthen a GABPA/ETS site in the TERT upstream enhancer and increase TERT in TERT-dependent cancers

links.claim: Hypothesis: alt A strengthens a GABPA/ETS site at chr5:1295601. No QBiC-SELEX row for GABPA was provided, so coverage is not_checked. GABPA is expressed in DepMap glioblastoma (median 15.52 TPM), but ENCODE GABPA ChIP-seq has no peak containing the variant in the cited 'null' biosamples; absence is not conclusive and no allele-specific binding assay is given.
The variant lies in an ENSR5 enhancer and within 500 bp of pELS/PLS cCREs near TERT, although no cCRE directly overlaps the variant.

TERT is the nearest TSS at 0.5 kb and the best L2G gene, but the credible set is hypertension with PIP 0.00 and E04 reports no GWAS Catalog association for rs34768248; TERT assignment is therefore indirect.

GABPA is expressed in the DepMap glioblastoma context, and TERT has broad literature relevance in melanoma/glioblastoma, but the evidence does not establish a GABPA-TERT axis in bladder cancer or in the cited DepMap subtype.

If alt A increased GABPA-driven TERT expression, higher telomerase activity could promote TERT-dependent cancer phenotypes; however, E06 is only generic TERT/telomerase literature and gives no rs34768248-specific or allele-specific phenotype evidence.

predictions: Allele-specific GABPA binding is higher for alt A than ref G at chr5:1295601.
TERT expression or regulatory activity is higher in cells carrying alt A, especially GABPA-expressing glioblastoma/melanoma/bladder cancer lines.
GABPA knockdown or mutation of the ETS site reduces the alt-A-specific effect.
falsified_if: No allele-specific GABPA binding is detected at chr5:1295601.
TERT expression or regulatory activity does not differ by allele in GABPA-expressing relevant cells.
GABPA knockdown or ETS-site mutation does not reduce any alt-A-specific effect.

chains.title: Ref G may be the stronger GABPA/ETS site; alt A may reduce GABPA binding and TERT expression

links.claim: Hypothesis: ref G preserves a stronger GABPA/ETS site than alt A. No QBiC-SELEX row for GABPA was provided, so coverage is not_checked. GABPA is expressed in DepMap glioblastoma, but no allele-specific GABPA ChIP, EMSA, or reporter data are given; E07 reports no GABPA ChIP peak containing the variant in the cited 'null' biosamples.
The variant lies in an ENSR5 enhancer and near pELS/PLS cCREs at TERT, making an allele-specific regulatory effect plausible, though no cCRE directly overlaps the variant.
TERT is the nearest TSS and best L2G gene, but the credible set is hypertension with PIP 0.00 and no GWAS Catalog association is reported for rs34768248, so the TERT link is indirect.
TERT is broadly relevant in some cancers in the literature, and GABPA is expressed in DepMap glioblastoma, but bladder-specific and GABPA-dependent TERT regulation are not shown.

If alt A reduced GABPA-driven TERT expression, telomerase activity would fall; this chain requires the alt allele to be protective or disease risk to act in the opposite direction, but no such direction or protective-allele evidence is provided.
